snippet.title: Aztecs: The Last Sun - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Release Date Announcement Trailer for Aztecs: The Last Sun, a city-builder management game developed by Play2Chill. Players will embody a ruler of the city-state of Tenochtitlan to develop the settlement, rule with fairness for the people, and remain in the favor of the Gods. Aztecs: The Last Sun is launching into Early Access on August 28 for PC (Steam).
